thesis: Agent A3 holds at the 10:00 ET tick. Following the 09:30 consensus fill, the shared book holds $249.67 (24.97% of sizing equity) in broad-market ballast via VTI, alongside $750.02 (75.03%) in cash, which comfortably clears the 15% cash floor. The news items published between 13:30 and 14:00 UTC are sparse and lack actionable fundamental drivers: an IPO commentary piece on private wearable device maker Oura provides no listed instrument to trade, while routine Item 8.01 filings (Oncolytics Biotech, Columbus Acquisition) and corporate debt disclosures lack fundamental valuation catalysts. Macro context signals rising yields (10Y yield at 5.268%, up 2.8 bps; 13W T-bill at 4.090%) and commentary from Morgan Stanley noting that an S&P 500 correction may be healthy, warranting caution. In accordance with the balanced mandate to mix ballast and equities only on distinct catalysts, and given that our core index ballast is already established at ~25%, we maintain our position, avoid forced speculation, and hold.
